description: SessionStart: keeps ~/.claude/brain-docs pointed at this plugin's docs, so CLAUDE.local.md Router paths survive version bumps and repo moves, and reports KERNEL drift in this plugin's own agent definitions. PostToolUse: reports KERNEL drift in whichever agents/ directory was just edited. Both drift checks are silent on pass — see hooks/kernel-check-hook.sh for why these two events and not CI or pre-commit.
